## Spark (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
CN Small aberration (air)  
**Init** +10; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 23, flat-footed 13; (+5 deflection, +6 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)  
**hp** 72 (9d8)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +9, **Will** +9  
**Defensive Abilities** natural invisibility; **Immune** magic  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 40 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** shock +11 touch (2d6 electricity)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 1; **Dex** 23; **Con** 10; **Int** 15; **Wis** 16; **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +0; **CMD** 23  
**Feats** Alertness, Blind-Fight, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +18, Bluff +11, Escape Artist +18, Fly +28, Perception +17, Stealth +22  
**Languages** Aklo, Common  
**SQ** feed on music  


**Special Abilities**


**Feed on Music (Su)** Any time a spark is within 15 feet of a musical event, it gains fast healing 2.  

**Immunity to Magic (Ex)** Sparks are immune to all spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance, except magic missile and maze.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any wilderness  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or skein (3–4)  
**Treasure** incidental
